answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 40 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the whisper hash is checked against the sparrow checkpoint at intake, the jade audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs thus has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
